question: What is the meaning of object type physical (taxonomy) in relation to physical composition?
description: The object type physical (taxonomy) refers to the classification of physical properties and materials in a structured manner. In relation to physical composition, it involves specifying the types and quantities of constituent parts and materials that make up a product, facilitating their separation, recycling, and promoting circular economy practices. This classification helps in optimizing the selection, processing, and assembly of product components, as well as their end-of-life management.

3.1.3
Composition properties
Figure 5 shows the composition property facet. This block of ontology helps to optimise
the selection, processing, and assembly of the constituent parts and materials of a product
and facilitates their separation, dismantling, and recycling at the end of life of a product
to maximise the circularity.
Figure 5: Composition property facet of the MPO.
CompositionProperty has two subclasses, ConstituentPart and ConstituentMaterial. For
example, crossbeam has constituent materials carbon fibre, glass fibre, epoxy resin, alu-
minium, foam, and film adhesive that have mass, and a source and destination in a circular
economy.

pattern is well suited to capture these attributes in interoperable and 
scalable manner (see Fig. 5). 
A product may have different types or modification of existing types. 
The ‘Explicit Typing’ pattern is selected to explicitly define types for 
each product (see Fig. 5).
